Questions

Before you ask

How long does a website take?+

Most sites launch in 7–10 days from the day I receive your content (logo, photos, text). I’ll confirm the exact timeline with you before we start.

What do you need from me?+

Your logo (if you have one), photos of your products or premises, and the words you want on the pages. No logo or photos yet? Tell me in the brief — I can work with what you have and advise on the rest.

Who owns the website?+

You do — the site, the domain and the content are yours. I hand everything over at launch with a short guide, and if you’d rather I keep looking after updates and backups afterwards, we can arrange that too.

Can you work with my existing site or shop?+

Yes — whether you have no site, an outdated one, or only a social media page, I can meet you where you are. Mention what you currently have in the brief.
